title: 高盛Ian Draiden：亚洲科技企业赴美上市，还有多少空间？
speaker: Ian Draiden

segments.en: Of course when we talk to issuers there will be questions about what's the forward pipeline. But equally I think you know, let's take a step back. There was a deficit of issuance essentially from 22 through 2024.
segments.zh: 当然，与发行人交流时会有关于未来项目储备的问题。但同样，让我们退一步看。从2022年到2024年，发行实际上存在缺口。

segments.en: Capital formation is essentially raising capital to fund growth organically or inorganically. And so there is a lot of pent-up demand. But per my earlier comment this pent-up demand from an issuer perspective, but also from an investor perspective.
segments.zh: 资本形成本质上是筹集资金以支持内生或外延增长。因此有大量被压抑的需求。正如我之前所说，这既来自发行人，也来自投资者。

segments.en: Um, ours was just talked about Goldman was potential advisor to the sokeoxia ADR listing. I'm just wondering maybe not to comment on specifically, but how are you looking at this whole pipeline of Asian tech companies chip makers that are accessing US capital markets. Do you see that as something that has a more runway?
segments.zh: 刚才谈到高盛可能是某公司ADR上市的潜在顾问。我不想具体评论，但你怎么看亚洲科技公司、芯片制造商进入美国资本市场的整体项目储备？你认为还有更多空间吗？

segments.en: Definitely has more runway. To put this into context in you know, the last kind of cycle or cyclical high was 2020-2021. Okay, where we saw a flurry of Chinese companies accessing the US markets. That's kind of gone away and so when we talk about and I obviously I can't comment on.
segments.zh: 肯定还有更多空间。上一轮周期高点在2020-2021年，当时大量中国企业进入美国市场。那已经过去了，所以当我们谈论，我显然不能评论。

segments.en: Deals that may come in the future, but when we talk about large deals out of Asia going to the US. I think SK high-nix would be a great example. That was a mega listing in July 26 and a half billion dollars. And so I can see that it will make sense according to certain countries and according to certain issuers.
segments.zh: 未来可能出现的交易，但当我们谈论亚洲大型企业赴美上市时，SK海力士是个很好的例子。那是7月的一次大型发行，260亿美元。所以我认为对某些国家和某些发行人来说，这是合理的。
